content_zh:
笼罩在迷蒙烟雨之中的汴京城，宛若一位入浴的佳人，褪去了平日里繁华喧嚣的外裳，任由这远道而来的天外之客，为她洗净沾染在身上的尘污，还她以清新空灵的原貌。
这场雨下了有一会儿了，所以街道上几乎没有什么行人，偶尔经过一两个也是脚步匆匆，很快便隐没在雨帘之中；两边的商铺由于生意冷清，大部分都早早地打烊歇息，更给这汴京城平添了几分幽寂。
突然，点花坊紧闭的乌木大门被人拉开了，从里面走出一个身穿浅蓝色长裙的女子。她抬头看了看天色，撑开手中同样天晴蓝的油纸伞，毫不迟疑地步入了雨中。
她走的很急，一双绣鞋没走几步就被雨水打湿了，就连荷叶边的裙摆也被不断撩起的泥水弄得污渍斑斑，可她连看都顾不上看一眼，只是匆匆忙忙赶路，像是去赶赴一场很重要的约会。
走了约莫两条街，她在一座门庭森严的大宅院前面停了下来，这正是她此行的目的地——凌殇阁。
“站住！”她刚欲进门，却被门口的守卫拦了下来，“你是什么人？到这里来做什么？”
蓝衣女子收起纸伞，一张清丽的小脸儿从伞下露了出来，“守卫大哥，我是来找人的，麻烦你通融一下，让我进去好吗？”
“找人？”守卫将她上上下下打量了一番，不耐烦地挥手，“去去去，这里没有你要找的人，到别处找去！”
“我真的是来找人的！”蓝衣女子见状，忙急切地解释道，“他今天刚刚抵达汴京城，就住在阁中，求求你让我进去找他好不好？”
“你可知道这是什么地方？凌殇阁重地，岂是你说进就进的？”见她不肯离去，守卫毫不怜惜地推了她一把，“赶快走，不然我对你不客气了！”
蓝衣女子被他推了一个趔趄，几乎跌倒在雨地里，勉强撑住自己的身子，她正要再求情，凌殇阁的大门突然被人拉开了，走出一位三十岁的中年男子，看到眼前的情景，他微微皱起眉头，“怎么回事？”
“回冯总管，有名女子说是来找人，箫阁主吩咐过不能随便让外人进阁，所以属下不敢擅自做主！”
这位中年男子正是凌殇阁的大总管冯渚，听完属下的回报，他看了蓝衣女子一眼，很快便认出了她的身份，“这不是点花坊的离烟姑娘吗？你是来找花坊主的吧，有急事？”
离烟迟疑了一下，点点头。
“那你进来吧。”冯渚说完便领着她进了凌殇阁，“花坊主也是刚刚才来，现正在箫阁主那里，我这就带你过去。”
“冯总管！”离烟叫住他，“我……我不是来找飘儿的。”
冯渚愣了一愣，刚才问她时她明明承认的，怎么才这么一会儿就变卦了？“那姑娘要找的是何人？”
“雪云霁。”
“你找阁主？”冯渚又是一愣，没想到新上任的阁主才成亲没两天，竟然就与青楼女子有了牵连，这要是让他大权在握的老丈人知道，后果可是不妙呀！
虽然为新主子捏了一把冷汗，但在凌殇阁供事多年，他比谁都明白，主子那些乱七八糟的情事，做下人还是少置喙为好，所以他什么也没问，只是将实情告知与她，“那可真是不巧，阁主他不在，今天一大早就陪夫人回长老院了，到现在还没有回来。”

“夫人？”这回愣住的人换成了离烟，“哪个夫人？”
“自然是阁主夫人！”冯渚不解她为何会如此问，只见她的脸色几乎是一瞬间变得惨白如洗，不由得担心地问道：“姑娘，你没什么事吧？”
“没事。”离烟回过神，缓缓地摇了摇头，“麻烦冯总管了，既然他不在，那我改天再来吧。”
辞别了冯渚，离烟举起似有千斤重的步子朝外面走去，手中的伞不知何时没了踪影，任由大雨将她从头到脚淋了个遍，脑子里始终盘旋不去的，是那个令她震惊不已的事实——他成亲了！
她无论如何也没有想到，自己为了能与他重聚忍辱偷生至今，结果换来的却是他另觅新欢，与她人结为了夫妻！
那么，她算什么？
喜欢久候了，小娘子请大家
content_en:
The city of Bianjing, shrouded in mist and mist, is like a beautiful lady taking a bath, taking off her bustling and noisy outer clothes, allowing this visitor from afar to wash away the dust and dirt on her body and return her to her original appearance of freshness and emptiness.
It has been raining for a while, so there are almost no pedestrians on the street. Occasionally, one or two pass by in a hurry and are quickly hidden in the rain curtain. Due to the deserted business, most of the shops on both sides have closed early for rest, which adds a bit of silence to Bianjing City.
Suddenly, the closed ebony door of Dianhuafang was opened, and a woman wearing a light blue dress walked out. She looked up at the sky, opened the oil-paper umbrella in her hand that was also clear and blue, and stepped into the rain without hesitation.
She walked in a hurry, and her embroidered shoes got wet from the rain after just a few steps, and even her ruffled skirt was stained by the muddy water that kept rising up. But she didn't even take a look, she just hurried on, as if she was rushing to a very important date.
After walking for about two streets, she stopped in front of a large mansion with a strict gate. This was the destination of her trip - Lingshang Pavilion.
"Stop!" She was about to enter, but was stopped by the guard at the door. "Who are you? What are you doing here?"
The woman in blue put away the paper umbrella, and a beautiful little face emerged from under the umbrella, "Brother guard, I'm here to find someone. Could you please be accommodating and let me in?"
"Looking for someone?" The guard looked her up and down and waved impatiently, "Go, go, there's no one you're looking for here, look elsewhere!"
"I'm really here to find someone!" Upon seeing this, the woman in blue explained hurriedly, "He just arrived in Bianjing today and is living in the pavilion. Please let me go in to find him, okay?"
"Do you know where this place is? You entered the important place of Lingshang Pavilion just when you asked?" Seeing that she refused to leave, the guard pushed her without mercy, "Leave quickly, or I will be rude to you!"
The woman in blue staggered when he pushed her, and almost fell into the rain. She could barely hold herself up. Just as she was about to plead again, the door of Lingshang Pavilion was suddenly opened, and a thirty-year-old middle-aged man walked out. Seeing the scene in front of him, he frowned slightly, "What's going on?"
"Back to Manager Feng, a woman said she was looking for someone. The master of Xiao Pavilion has told not to let outsiders into the pavilion casually, so my subordinates don't dare to make decisions without permission!"
This middle-aged man was Feng Zhu, the chief manager of Lingshang Pavilion. After hearing the reports from his subordinates, he glanced at the woman in blue and quickly recognized her identity, "Isn't this Miss Li Yan from Dian Hua Fang? Are you here to see the owner of the flower shop? Is there something urgent?"
Li Yan hesitated for a moment and nodded.
"Then come in." After Feng Zhu said that, he led her into Lingshang Pavilion. "The flower shop master also just came here. He is now at the Xiao Pavilion master. I will take you there right now."
"Manager Feng!" Li Yan stopped him, "I...I'm not here to see Piao'er."
Feng Zhu was stunned for a moment. She had clearly admitted it when he asked her just now. Why did she change her mind so quickly? "Who is the girl looking for?"
"Xue Yunji."
"Are you looking for the pavilion master?" Feng Zhu was stunned again. He didn't expect that the newly appointed pavilion master would be involved with a brothel girl just two days after getting married. If his powerful father-in-law knew about this, the consequences would be bad!
Although he was worried about his new master, he had served in the Lingshang Pavilion for many years and he understood better than anyone else that as a servant it was better not to talk about the messy affairs of the master, so he didn't ask anything and just told her the truth, "That's really unfortunate. The master of the pavilion is not here. He accompanied his wife back to the Elder's House early this morning, and he hasn't come back yet."
"Madam?" This time the person who was stunned was Li Yan, "Which madam?"
"Of course it's the lady of the pavilion.! "Feng Zhu didn't understand why she asked this. He saw that her face turned pale almost instantly. He couldn't help but asked worriedly: "Girl, are you okay? "
"fine. Li Yan came back to her senses and shook her head slowly, "I'm sorry to bother Mr. Feng. Since he's not here, I'll come back another day." "
After bidding farewell to Feng Zhu, Li Yan walked outside with steps that seemed to weigh a thousand pounds. The umbrella in her hand disappeared at some point. She let the heavy rain soak her from head to toe. The thing that couldn't get out of her mind was the fact that shocked her - he was married!
She never imagined that she had endured humiliation in order to be reunited with him, but in exchange, he would find a new love and marry her!
So, who is she?
I've been waiting for a long time, my dear lady, please
